35:22.text: . Verily, Allâh makes whom He wills to hear, but you cannot make hear those who are in graves.

35:23.text: (i.e. your duty is to convey Allâh’s Message to mankind but the guidance is Allâh’s)

35:24.text: Verily We have sent you with the truth, a bearer of glad tidings and a warner. And there never was a nation but a warner had passed among them.

35:25.text: And if they belie you, those before them also belied. Their Messengers came to them with clear signs, and with the Scriptures, and the book giving light.

35:26.text: Then I took hold of those who disbelieved: and how terrible was My denial

35:27.text: See you not that Allâh sends down water
from the sky, and We produce therewith fruits of various colours, and among the mountains are streaks white and red, of varying colours and

35:28.text: And likewise of men and Ad-Dawâbb
, and cattle, are of various colours. It is only those who have knowledge among His slaves that fear Allâh. Verily, Allâh is All-Mighty, Oft-Forgiving.
